glossary.definition: (1) "Distributive award" means any payment or payments, in real or personal property, that are payable in a lump sum or over time, in fixed amounts, that are made from separate property or income, and that are not made from marital property and do not constitute payments of spousal support, as defined in section 3105.18 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3105.171 - Equitable division of marital and separate property - distributive award.

glossary.definition:
(2) "During the marriage" means whichever of the following is applicable:

(a) Except as provided in division (A)(2)(b) of this section, the period of time from the date of the marriage through the date of the final hearing in an action for divorce or in an action for legal separation;
glossary.source_title: Section 3105.171 - Equitable division of marital and separate property - distributive award.

glossary.definition: (b) If the court determines that the use of either or both of the dates specified in division (A)(2)(a) of this section would be inequitable, the court may select dates that it considers equitable in determining marital property. If the court selects dates that it considers equitable in determining marital property, "during the marriage" means the period of time between those dates selected and specified by the court.
glossary.source_title: Section 3105.171 - Equitable division of marital and separate property - distributive award.
Section 3105.171 - Equitable division of marital and separate property - distributive award.

glossary.definition: (b) "Marital property" does not include any separate property.
glossary.source_title: Section 3105.171 - Equitable division of marital and separate property - distributive award.

glossary.definition: (4) "Passive income" means income acquired other than as a result of the labor, monetary, or in-kind contribution of either spouse.
glossary.source_title: Section 3105.171 - Equitable division of marital and separate property - distributive award.

glossary.definition: (5) "Personal property" includes both tangible and intangible personal property.
glossary.source_title: Section 3105.171 - Equitable division of marital and separate property - distributive award.
